Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Scott,
If a vampire, say Masika with 4 blood, plays entrenching. He then pays for
several action modifiers, which bring him below 4 blood. The action is
unblocked. Does he still gain the results of entrenching even though he no
longer has more than 3 blood?

--
Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> If a vampire, say Masika with 4 blood, plays entrenching. He then pays for
> several action modifiers, which bring him below 4 blood. The action is
> unblocked. Does he still gain the results of entrenching even though he no
> longer has more than 3 blood?

No. He only gains if he has four or more blood, by card text.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
UniqueMaster wrote:
> Can any minion attempt this action, regardless of blood/vampire state?
>
> Card text:
>
> Entrenching:
> +1 stealth action. If this vampire has 4 or more blood, he or she gains 4
> blood.
>
> I don't see any "Requires" text on the card.

Any vampire can. Card text "this vampire" implies that requirement
(see also Taste of Vitae). So long as he has at least one blood,
of course (with none, he'd have to hunt).

If he has one blood, he could attempt the action, get blocked,
punch for 3, prevent the damage done to him, taste (3), press,
and then Form of Mist to complete the action. Since he has 4 blood
at resolution, he'd gain 4 more.


